steps.note: S2.4.1 only asserts the lemma's statement (adds x_S to y_S for arbitrary initial scratch values); it gives neither the net change (JV+RG)x nor the row-by-row subtract/add/restore argument of the proof, so the independence is asserted without its derivation.

S2.4.3.1 says only that coefficients depend on the intersection size and side wires cancel the unwanted ones; the bit-case central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2, the intersection-one cancellation and the self coefficient one are not stated.
The complex-case central coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2 and the cancellation of intersections zero and two appear nowhere in the plan.

S2.4.1 asserts that three stages give (X_a,Y_a) -> (-Y_a,X_a) and restore scratch wires, but not the stage chain (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) nor the forward/inverse/forward schedule; result without the derivation.

The plan states only that every edge joins comparable nondegenerate labels (S2.4.3.2) and that an edge's cost is its orthogonal residual dimension; the per-edge residual table and its dimensions are absent.
No mention of the side edge 2->5, t_X ⊥ t_Y, the inclusion <t_X> in t_Y^perp, or the residual <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2.

S2.4.3.2 states the lemma's conclusions (only decreasing edges are center 3->4 losing h, L=Ich, absolute sum Wm-2N+2L) but not the telescoping derivation (sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N), so the result is asserted without the sub-step.
The plan uses an orthonormal basis of the residual (S2.4.3.5) but never says residuals are nondegenerate and nonalternating over F_2 or how alternating planes are absorbed.
S2.4.3.3 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, quoting the paper line.
No statement of weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors or of q_V-q_U as a sum of wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal basis; S2.4.3.5 only asserts the kernel product.
The plan asserts one kernel aI+bX_v per basis vector (S2.4.3.5, S2.6.1) but never gives wt(v) odd, the phase i^{eps[v.x]} or the identity H diag(1,-1) H = X.

S2.6.1.2 gives each basis vector one tensored child (C^{±1})^{⊗f} on the f columns/axes of a slot and S2.6.1.3 sums to exactly s_c child calls, matching the paper's one factor per residual vector and s_c in all.

The plan has the identity for inverse children (S2.6.1.3) but nothing on zero/full label frames, the X_a->Y_a pair carrying C^{-1} on 27 coordinates, the Z_{a,k} and i^{27k} repair, or negating the X outputs.
Both L/N ratios are stated below 1/2 (S2.4.3.3), the deficit N-2L_b>0 is stated (S2.4.3.4.3) and s_b<W_b m and s_c<W_c m are stated (S2.4.3.4, S2.4.3.5).
The value eta_b = 339/22587335000000 does not appear in the plan.
The value eta_c = 73/19906842167500 does not appear in the plan.

S2.4.4 states that deficits exceed 20*2^{-50} and log m<20, hence tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} gives s/W<m^tau for both networks; the intermediate inequality m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-eta) is not written but the stated chain is the paper's.
S2.4.5.1 only states the factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 with Pi having exactly a ones (the lemma); the pivot/elimination proof is not given.
No mention of a fixed odd prime avoiding denominators in a finite table of factors or of specializing the identities to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors.

S2.4.5's motivation says controlled shifts update a later field from earlier fields in linear time so a lower-triangular change of coordinates costs O(V), with the method citing controlled shifts in tape order; the descending order is only implicit (weakest present verdict).
S2.4.5.2 gives H_i <- H_i + D_j via D_j <- D_j + H_i, one interchange, and D_j <- H_i - D_j, using exactly a interchanges.
The plan never defines E, B, nu, C_1, C_0 or Delta; S2.6.3.5 only names the guard width ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) as o(p).
The arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E (leaf A(e)<=8e) is not in the plan; S2.6.3.5 only asserts that the guard width is o(p).
No unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu or bound A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} appears in the plan.

S2.6.3.5 asserts exactness with guard width o(p) (quoting 'Choose epsilon C_1<1') but gives neither the depth-ell bounds (2^{-(p+ell)}Z[i], modulus <=2^ell) nor the p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits.
S2.6.3.6 asserts coefficients in the unit disk and error below sqrt2 2^{-p} but never says every row of H has absolute row sum one, which is why disks are preserved.

summary: P07 follows the paper's lemma and proposition statements closely (quoting statement lines) but largely omits their proofs. Present: L5 (loss ratios), P3 (one tensored factor per residual vector, s_c in all), R1 (L/N<1/2, deficit N-2L>0, s<Wm), R4 (deficits exceed 20*2^-50 and log m<20, giving tau=sigma=1-2^-50), M3 (lower-triangular O(V) via controlled shifts, weakest) and M4 (one interchange per one of Pi). Absent: all of the bank-exchange proof details (B1-B4), the residual table, side edge, telescoping and nonalternating basis (L1-L4), the weight-additivity and endpoint-repair derivations (P1, P2, P4), the explicit eta values (R2, R3), the elimination proof and prime choice (M1, M2), and the whole guard-width and row-sum analysis (S1-S5).
